== Biography ==
{{African-American Sticker}}
Joseph was born around 1790, in Richmond, Virginia. His probable father is Thomas, indexed as Glasgo in the 1877 Campbell death entry; the same entry names mother Rose. The match of that deceased man to this Roanoke family remains an inference.<ref name="Campbell 1877">"Virginia, Deaths and Burials, 1853-1912", FamilySearch, [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X5Y6-54C Joseph Glasgo, 1 September 1877], film 2056976, image 45; original Campbell death register, James River District,1877, film2056976, image 45, inspected 23October2026; [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:S3HT-6LS7-3D7 original image].</ref>

The 1866 cohabitation-register account dates his cohabitation with [[Gilbert-25488|Lucy Gilbert]] from 4 July 1839; it does not independently establish a wedding on that day. They had the following known children.
#[[Glasgow-3719|Caroline Glasgow]] b. 1839 - d. 1910, m. Charles Lewis
#[[Glasgow-3720|Mary Glasgow]] b. abt. 1841 - d. 1921, m. Archie Warren
#[[Glasgow-3721|Sarah Glasgow]] b. abt. 1843 - d. aft. 1866
#[[Glasgow-3718|Rebecca Glasgow]] b. abt. 1848 - d. 1926, m. Thomas Clark
#[[Glasgow-3722|Joseph Glasgow]] b. abt. 1849 - d. 1914, m. Judy Ann Jackson
#[[Glasgow-2574|John Glasgow]] b. abt. 1851 - d. 1917, m1/wid. Lucy Brown Marshall, m2. Caroline Wright, m3. Sarah Smith
#[[Glasgow-2575|Nancy Glasgow]] b. abt. 1856 - d. 1922, m. William Trent
#[[Glasgow-3723|Collins Glasgow]] b. abt. 1860 - d. 1923, m1. Eliza Jane Price, m2. Bernie UNK
#[[Glasgow-2576|Lucy Glasgow]] b. abt. 1862 - d. 1945, m. Julius Williams

He died on 1 September 1877, in Campbell County, Virginia. The informant is written J. Glasgo, designated Son; identification with his son Joseph is inferred.<ref>'''Death''': "Virginia, Deaths and Burials, 1853-1912", database, FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X5Y6-54C : 29 January 2020), Joseph Glasgo, 1877.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
Interestingly there is another Joseph Glasgow who died that same year in Campbell, Virginia. However, he was a little older and his death record stated he was born in Washington, D.C.

=== Probable father and death-entry identity ===

Thomas is the probable working father of Roanoke Joseph Glasgow-2573 at74%. The inspected 1877 Campbell original explicitly names Thomas and Rose Glasgo as parents of Jos. Glasgo and records J. Glasgo, Son, as informant. The 1866 cohabitation-register-derived account identifies Joe, Lucy Gilbert and nine children. The younger Joseph’s held 1878 marriage and 1880/1900 Campbell households supply a plausible family continuation, supporting the existing identification of the elder Joseph’s Campbell death. Its conflicting birthplace, age and Unmarried entry remain unresolved. Parent names already appeared in the biography; this is a qualified structured father selection, not newly discovered names or a merger of existing branches.

The original 1877 entry gives age 80 and a ditto Campbell birthplace, whereas the Roanoke account gives Richmond and the 1870 census age 80 implies about 1790. Its consort column repeats Unmarried rather than naming Lucy. The informant is J. Glasgo, designated Son, without a full forename. The younger Joseph’s1914 certificate clearly names mother Lucy Gilbert, but its father abbreviation remains ambiguous Jas./Jos.; independent readings prefer Jas., and the father’s birthplace is uncertain, tentatively Fredericktown, Md. It does not resolve the 1877 deceased’s identity or name Thomas. Census and marriage household accounts are reused captures, not freshly inspected images. Companion death indexes concern the same event. No existing numbered Thomas, marriage to Rose, older Glasgow lineage or common Y-DNA origin is established.

74% rates the full proposition that the Roanoke family’s Joseph had the Thomas named in this particular Campbell death entry as father. The indexed father role is explicit; the match of the deceased to the Roanoke man is inferred. Thomas’s identity remains on HOLD, with no birth/death dates or birthplace assigned and no WikiTree creation/save authorized by this local selection.
